notes: Starting cards as posted (marked '(s)'): Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can, Dagobah, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Your Insight Serves You Well, Battle Plan and The Way Of Things; these count toward the 60. Your Insight Serves You Well is shown as the starting effect.
The strategy's update says Anakin's Podracer was later swapped out for Melas; the list is kept as published (Anakin's Podracer, no Melas).

Posted 'BP' dested Battle Plan (Light Endor Effect, a starting Effect here); 'HotJ' dested Honor Of The Jedi; 'DtF' dested Draw Their Fire; 'AFA' dested Anger, Fear, Aggression; 'YISYW' dested Your Insight Serves You Well.
Posted 'Jungle' and 'Swamp' (listed with the Dagobah sites) dested Dagobah: Jungle and Dagobah: Swamp; 'CC Incinerator' dested the Light Cloud City: Incinerator.
Posted 'EPP Obi' / 'EPP Luke' / 'EPP Han' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber, Luke With Lightsaber and Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'DOS' dested Daughter Of Skywalker; 'EG-4' dested EG-4 (Eegee-Four).

Posted 'Waaooooww' dested WHAAAAAAAAAOOOOW! (Light Dagobah interrupt, destiny 7, fits the 'lots of destiny 7s' strategy); 'Anakin's Saber' dested Anakin's Lightsaber; 'Anakin's Pracer' dested Anakin's Podracer.
Wise Advice is the Special Edition Effect (an Effect, not a Defensive Shield, in 2001).
Posted 'Jedi Tests #1-6' dested the six Jedi Tests: Great Warrior, A Jedi's Strength, Domain Of Evil, Size Matters Not, It Is The Future You See, You Must Confront Vader.
Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 5 July 2001, before Coruscant, with no Coruscant cards.
